title: Nickname
description: Personalize your experience! Set a custom nickname and show off animated GIFs above your character with this easy-to-use mod.
body:
✨ Key Features
Custom Nicknames: Set a custom display name for your character. Perfect for roleplay or personal branding.

Animated GIF Support: Express yourself! Easily display animated GIFs above your character's head to catch everyone's attention.

Privacy Mode: Hide your real Minecraft username in the chat and on your player label to keep your account identity private.

Intuitive GUI: Access your settings effortlessly with an in-game configuration menu. (Default key: J)

Lightweight & Non-Intrusive: Built to be performance-friendly. It’s a client-side mod, meaning it works on any server without requiring the server owner to install it!

🎮 How to Use
1-Install the mod and launch the game.

2-Press the J key to open the configuration menu.

3-Enter your desired nickname and toggle your preferences.

Save and enjoy your new look!

⚙️ Requirements
Minecraft: 1.20.1

Loader: Fabric

Dependency: Fabric API

💬 Support
If you encounter any bugs or have suggestions for new features, please feel free to leave a comment or report an issue on our GitHub repository.

Stand out. Be unique. Use Nickname.
